paper.abstract_en: We study whether symplectic quandle colorings can reveal causal structure encoded by "sky links", the links formed by the spheres of all light rays through two events in the space of light rays of a $(2+1)$-dimensional globally hyperbolic spacetime. The testbed is the connected sum of two Hopf links $H$ (causally unrelated events) and the infinite family of Allen-Swenberg links $L_n$, which the Alexander-Conway polynomial cannot tell apart from $H$. We use the enhanced quandle counting polynomial, in which every coloring is weighted by the size of the subquandle generated by its colors. For the 16-element symplectic quandle $T=(\mathbb{Z}/4)^2$ we prove that $|\mathrm{Hom}(Q(L_n),T)| = 640 + 96\cdot 16^n$ for every $n\ge 1$, while $|\mathrm{Hom}(Q(H),T)| = 736$, and we determine the enhanced polynomial of every $L_n$. Hence already the plain quandle counting invariant distinguishes $H$ from every Allen-Swenberg link, and the Allen-Swenberg links from each other. Analogous closed formulas hold for $(\mathbb{Z}/2)^4$ and for an 8-element degenerate symplectic quandle $(\mathbb{Z}/2)^3$ ($176+48\cdot 16^n$ versus $224$), and the quandle $(\mathbb{Z}_7)^2$ also separates $H$ from the whole family. Over $(\mathbb{Z}_p)^2$ the enhanced polynomial carries at most one number beyond the counting invariant, and whether it separates $L_1$ from $H$ depends on $p$: it does for $p=7,11,17,19,23,31$ and does not for $p=2,3,5,13$. The proofs combine an exact transfer-matrix description of the family with certified finite computations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将纽结理论中的辛圈（quandle）着色不变量用于探测因果结构，研究对象为光射线空间中由“天空链”形成的链，属于广义相对论基础中因果结构的数学探测方向；文中给出精确转移矩阵描述与有限计算证明，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，且首次用圈着色区分 Allen-Swenberg 链族与 Hopf 链，新意明确。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究辛圈着色能否揭示由“天空链”（sky links）编码的因果结构，这些链由 $(2+1)$ 维全局双曲时空的光射线空间中两个事件所对应的所有光线的球面形成。测试平台是两个 Hopf 链 $H$（因果无关的事件）的连通和以及 Allen-Swenberg 链的无限族 $L_n$，Alexander-Conway 多项式无法将 $L_n$ 与 $H$ 区分开。我们使用增强圈计数多项式，其中每个着色都按其颜色生成的子圈的大小加权。对于 16 元辛圈 $T=(\mathbb{Z}/4)^2$，我们证明对每个 $n\ge 1$ 有 $|\mathrm{Hom}(Q(L_n),T)| = 640 + 96\cdot 16^n$，而 $|\mathrm{Hom}(Q(H),T)| = 736$，并且我们确定了每个 $L_n$ 的增强多项式。因此，仅普通的圈计数不变量就已经将 $H$ 与每一个 Allen-Swenberg 链区分开，也将 Allen-Swenberg 链彼此区分开。类似的封闭公式对 $(\mathbb{Z}/2)^4$ 以及一个 8 元退化辛圈 $(\mathbb{Z}/2)^3$ 成立（$176+48\cdot 16^n$ 对 $224$），并且圈 $(\mathbb{Z}_7)^2$ 也能将 $H$ 与整个族分开。在 $(\mathbb{Z}_p)^2$ 上，增强多项式至多携带一个超出计数不变量的数，并且它能否将 $L_1$ 与 $H$ 分开取决于 $p$：对 $p=7,11,17,19,23,31$ 可以，而对 $p=2,3,5,13$ 不行。证明结合了该族的精确转移矩阵描述与经过认证的有限计算。
